trust: Offline — files never leave this computer
outNext: Saving next to the original file
dropTitle: Drop a PDF here to get started
notPdf: That doesn't look like a PDF. Drop a .pdf file instead.
dropSub: We'll suggest the right tool, or you can pick one below.
toolsHeading: What would you like to do?
suggestLead: Here's what you can do with this file
mergeDesc: Combine several PDFs into one file, in the order you choose.
splitDesc: Break a PDF into separate files by page or range.
organizeDesc: Reorder, rotate, delete or add pages.
compressDesc: Make a PDF smaller for email or upload.
wordDesc: Rebuild an editable document, keeping the layout.
excelDesc: Turn a PDF into a spreadsheet that looks like the original.
ocrDesc: Make scanned PDFs searchable and editable.
editDesc: White-out, add text, signatures and stamps.
emptyMerge: Drop the PDFs you want to merge
emptySplit: Drop the PDF you want to split
emptyOrganize: Drop a PDF to organize its pages
emptyCompress: Drop PDFs to compress: one, many, a folder or a ZIP
emptyWord: Drop the PDF you want to turn into a Word document
emptyExcel: Drop a PDF to turn into a spreadsheet
emptyHint: Any size is fine. Nothing is uploaded; the work happens on this computer.
nextTo: next to the original. Your original is never changed.
inFolder: in Documents\majipdf. Your original is never changed.
mergeHint: Drag the cards, or use the arrows, to set the order.
compressResultHint: A smaller file that looks the same.
splitRangesHint: Choose exactly which pages go together
splitNHint: Same number of pages in each file
splitNotIncluded: Pages outside your ranges are left out.
rangeErr: Page {p} doesn't exist. This file has {max} pages.
rangeErrFormat: "{x}" isn't a range we understand. Try something like 2-4.
orgHint: Click a page to select it. Hold Ctrl or Shift to select several. Drag to move.
smallestHint: 72 DPI · Best for email. Photos look softer.
printHint: 300 DPI · Keeps fine detail for printing.
targetHint: We'll try different settings until each file fits, and keep the best-looking result.
grayHint: Removes color. Often makes files much smaller.
pwWrong: That password didn't work. Check Caps Lock and try again.
noReduction: Already as small as it can get. We kept your original and made no new file.
underTarget: Already under {t}. We kept your original.
missTarget: Couldn't get this under {t}. The smallest we reached is {s}. Keep it?
skippedPw: Skipped because it needs a password.
largeNote: Large file. This can take a few minutes; the page counter keeps moving as each page is done.
exactHint: Best for rebuilding a lost original. Text stays where it was on the page.
flowHint: Easier to edit. Spacing may shift a little.
tablesFound: {n} tables found on {p} pages. Tick the ones you want in the spreadsheet.
perTableHint: Each table gets its own tab.
oneSheetHint: Stacked with a blank row between.
numbersHint: So you can add them up in Excel.
scannedTitle: This looks like a scanned document
scannedWord: The pages are pictures of text, so the Word file will mostly contain images you can't edit. Text recognition (OCR) is coming in a later version.
scannedExcel: Pages without a text layer will come out empty until text recognition (OCR) is available.
officeWordTitle: Microsoft Word isn't installed on this computer
officeExcelTitle: Microsoft Excel isn't installed on this computer
officeBody: majipdf uses {app} on this computer to build the file, which is how your document stays offline. Ask your IT team to install Microsoft Office, then click Check again.
officeMeanwhile: Merge, Split, Organize and Compress still work without it.
procNote: You can keep using your computer. Closing majipdf will stop this task.
savedNext: Saved next to the original in Documents › Keuangan › 2026
doneSubSplit: Your pages are split into separate files.
errBody: {f} seems to be damaged, or it isn't really a PDF.
errTry1: Open it in your usual PDF reader. If it opens, choose Print, then Save as PDF to make a clean copy, and try again.
errTry2: If it came by email or download, ask for it to be sent again.
signedBody: Changing this file will make its digital signature invalid in the new file. Your original stays untouched and keeps its signature.
damagedMeta: Can't open this file · it will be skipped
compressFailed: Couldn't compress this file. Your original is unchanged.
lockedSkip1: 1 locked file will be skipped. Unlock it in the file list to include it.
lockedSkip: {n} locked files will be skipped. Unlock them in the file list to include them.
mergeLockedSkip1: 1 locked file will be skipped. Unlock it in the file list to include it.
mergeLockedSkip: {n} locked files will be skipped. Unlock them in the file list to include them.
everyNErr: Enter a whole number from 1 to {max}.
orgReplaceQ: Choose a different file? Your changes so far will be lost.
wordNote: Uses Microsoft Word on this computer. Layout and pictures are kept as Word reads them.
wordBgNote: Word runs invisibly in the background. If it shows up in the taskbar, that's normal.
wordErrBody: Microsoft Word stopped while converting {f}. Try again, or open the PDF in Word yourself.
xlsSheetsPageHint: Each PDF page gets its own tab.
xlsSheetsOneHint: Stacked with a blank row between pages.
xlsNumbersOff: Values are copied exactly as shown in the PDF.
xlsNumbersOn: Lets you calculate in Excel, but numbers will display in this computer's regional format (e.g. 89,65 may appear as 89.65).
xlsBgNote: Excel runs invisibly in the background. If it shows up in the taskbar, that's normal.
xlsEmptyPages: {n} page(s) had no readable text (scanned) and are empty.
xlsOther: Not right? Try the other method
xlsOtherHint: Uses Microsoft Excel. Saves a second file ending in _v2.
xlsErrTitle: Couldn't convert this file to Excel
xlsErrBody: Something went wrong while converting {f}. Try again, or use "Copy details for IT" and send it to your IT team.
xlsMissingBody: The other method needs Microsoft Excel on this computer. Your first file is still saved.
